description: Lets a coach's Pistachio workspace send email from their own domain, through Resend (built on Amazon SES): the DKIM key, the bounce (MAIL FROM) records on send.<domain> and Resend's return-path record. Mail the domain already receives or sends is not touched: nothing is written on the domain's own MX or SPF.
variableDescription: %dkim%: the DKIM public key Resend issues for the domain (the base64 part after p=). %region%: the Amazon SES region the domain sends from, e.g. us-east-1. %returnpath%: the first label of Resend's return-path host, e.g. send in send.forge.rmta.net.
